recomputed_cases_I_VII.scope: Historical printed metrics paired by case_id/run_index; repeated baseline case entries preserved.

historical_reported_all_cases.status: Reported rounded console aggregates; full slope/broadness point data unavailable.

conditional_penetration_check_including_.mask_basis: Uses all five Case VIII pairs as reported by the historical aggregate count, without deriving their missing entrance/slope masks.
conditional_penetration_check_including_.csv_masks_remain: unknown for Model A Case VIII

paper_reported_approximate_aggregates.note: Approximate paper values; not exact pass/fail targets for this archive.

limitations: No fresh MATLAB model run was performed for this dataset.
A metrics preserve console rounding, not full floating-point solver outputs.
Case VIII A entrance, slope, broadness and validity are not recorded.
B NaN arrays do not establish the cause of raw missing metrics.
No historical coverage profiles or per-run residuals are archived.
